qwen36_27b.note: RE-BASED onto job 16811726, which resolves the provenance splice the previous row carried: accuracy, tokens, latency and energy now all come from ONE run (85 tasks scored, 49 solved) instead of energy from a 44/89 run paired with accuracy from a 45/89 run whose serving config was never logged. The new run also serves at the model's native 262144 context with the qwen3_xml parser, where the retired one served 131072. Accuracy moves 50.6% -> 55.1% and energy 78.0 -> 82.7 kJ/task; the +4.5 pt is the context change, measured (Qwen3.8 moved -3.4 pt on the same change, so this is model-specific, not universal). Against Qwen's published 63.4 on TB 2.1/Terminus this sits 8.3 points low, a scaffold-level offset that also affects every other local tier.

gemma_4_31b.method: verify_ladder_power.py -- re-integrated the source power CSV, since this cell is imported and has no local run tree for harvest_cell.py to read
gemma_4_31b.note: Imported from HF ipj-tb-ladder-runs. The published 12.58 MJ sits 9.5% under the 13.78 MJ all-board integral, consistent with a tighter measure window; the trace contains exactly the two allocated boards, so the whole-node defect its own README warns about was not present here.

GLM_local.note: First GLM energy measurement; replaces the 537 kJ/task ESTIMATE, which it comes in 15.5% BELOW -- the estimate was correctly labelled an upper bound. All eight allocated boards observed 99.3-99.4% active with the trace's board count matching n_gpus=8. CAVEAT, same shape as qwen36_27b's: this run resolved 57/89 while the spine's GLM_local accuracy is 58/89 from a different run, so the row pairs energy and accuracy from two runs one task apart. Landed only after four preemptions at PriorityTier 5; this run held sphinx10 in the sphinx partition (tier 1000).

M3_local.note: Last local energy cell; takes the board to 4/4. Took five attempts: four preemptions at PriorityTier 5 masked a real serving failure, and the block-size wall then took three tries -- 16 and 32 both refused before reading M3's own sparse_attention.py, which returns [128]. Served at 98304 rather than 131072 because block-size 128 leaves only 4.63 GiB for KV on four boards. This run supplies accuracy, tokens, latency AND energy together, superseding the --metrics-only telemetry taken from mm3_cascade_sat (52/89) while M3 was unservable; accuracy moves 49/89 -> 53/89.
